description: Human-reviewed English labels for public KIMSE Evidence readiness. No clinical assertions added.

translations.사용자 검증 제외 6개 영역의 증빙 확보 정도: Evidence availability across six areas, excluding user validation
translations.6개 영역 65% + 사용자 검증 35%: Six areas weighted 65%, user validation weighted 35%
translations.현재 점수는 문서·구현·검증 자료 충족도이며 제품 출시 승인, 의료 유효: These scores reflect the availability of documentation, implementation and verification evidence. They do not represent product approval, clinical effectiveness or a likelihood of raising investment.
translations.전체 35개 점검 항목과 점수 계산 기준: All 35 review items and scoring methodology
Each area is assessed against five items.
Evidence scoring data could not be loaded, so no score is shown.
